comments.author: FDUguchunhui
comments.body:
In baseline.py:

Change code 
```
def forward(self, input, target):
        target = target.view(input.shape)
        loss = F.binary_cross_entropy(input, target, reduction='none')
        loss[target == self.masked_with] = 0
        return loss.sum()
```

to

```
def forward(self, input, target):
        target = target.view(input.shape)
        # only calculate loss on target pixels (value = -1)
        loss = F.binary_cross_entropy(input[target != self.masked_with], target[target != self.masked_with], 
reduction='none')
        # loss[target == self.masked_with] = 0
        return loss.sum()
```

After that, I have successfully ran the code in python==2.2.0 and pyro=1.8.6
